label: [PS] Know Your Rights
heading: [PS] Know Your Rights
description: [PS] Understanding your rights is the first step to protecting yourself and your family.

police.title: [PS] When Interacting with Police or Immigration Agents
items: [PS] You do not have to answer questions about your immigration status.
[PS] You may say: "I want to remain silent."
[PS] You have the right to refuse a search without a warrant.
[PS] Ask for a lawyer before signing anything.

ice.title: [PS] If ICE Comes to Your Home
items: [PS] Do NOT open the door without a signed warrant.
[PS] Ask to see it through the window or under the door.
[PS] You have the right to remain silent.

documents.title: [PS] Carrying Documents Safely
items: [PS] Avoid carrying your passport unless advised.
[PS] Store important documents safely at home.

disclaimer: [PS] This information is for educational purposes only and does not constitute legal advice. For legal assistance, please contact an immigration attorney or an approved legal service provider.
